purpose: Screen of the arms admitted by the series-3 L-A attribution on the promoted Torch 2.13 runtime; same clips, gates and order rule as tail_screen_20260911; production defaults unchanged; no visible-ACK, human-quality or default-promotion claim.
fixed_argv: --profile standard --no-tts --stt-backend parakeet-mlx --model-family gemma4 --gemma4-size e4b --vad-backend torch --no-mts --gain 1 --replay-speed 1 (all other settings at production defaults, final-aware partials on)
clip_selection: Same speech-dense offsets as the frozen 150 s clips (1290 s / 1170 s), extended to 360 s. Declared coverage floor 0.75: the best 360 s window anywhere in the 2_8_26 sermon reaches only 0.777, measured before any run; neither window has a 5 s no-speech interval with RMS > 0.15.

admission.arm2_marian_threads_2: live Gemma tok/s p50 29.2 vs isolated 33-35 (-13 %); pipeline process CPU p95 115-143 % of one core during traced control replays while Marian previews run -> mechanism present (CPU-side contention)
admission.arm3_max_utterance_6: smart cuts 240/606 pooled finals (40 %), p50 3085 ms vs silence p50 1566 ms (+1.5 s) -> mechanism present (policy-driven long finals)
admission.arm4_partial_recheck_translation: 34.6 % of Gemma decode time overlapped by partial STT; slow-decode median overlap 33 %; 613/4815 partial STT calls started while a translation was active -> mechanism present

marian_threads_2.hypothesis: Marian CT2 previews with 4 intra-threads contend with the MLX host thread; 2 threads reduce CPU-side contention during Gemma decode

max_utterance_6.hypothesis: Capping utterances at 6 s shortens smart/hard-cut finals (35-43 tokens) and their decode tail; a policy arm
max_utterance_6.quality_guard: G4 identity fails by construction (segmentation changes); substitute guard: no empty or duplicated finals and WER of the concatenated Spanish finals vs the control concatenation <= +1 pt (jiwer); preview guard G5 applies; a PASS only qualifies the arm for Willem's review

partial_recheck_translation.hypothesis: Skipping a queued partial STT at worker admission while a Gemma translation is active removes ~35 % overlap of decode time

order: per clip: ctl,marian_threads_2,max_utterance_6,partial_recheck_translation | partial_recheck_translation,max_utterance_6,marian_threads_2,ctl | ctl,partial_recheck_translation,marian_threads_2,max_utterance_6 (3 repeats per configuration, controls at both ends, candidate order reversed in the middle repetition); clip A then clip B; 24 runs

gates.G1_primary: gemma-routed silence-final speech_end_to_final_ms nearest-rank p95 (pooled over 3 repeats per clip): arm <= 0.85*ctl or arm <= ctl-300 ms, on both clips
gates.G2: all-route silence-final p95 and pooled smart_cut+hard_cut p95 not worse than ctl + max(5 %,100 ms)
gates.G3: all-route silence-final p50 not worse than ctl + max(5 %,50 ms)
gates.G4_identity: >= 95 % byte-identical translated finals vs the same-repeat control run (aligned by row order); every difference listed
gates.G5_previews: preview count per run >= 98 % of the clip's mean control count
gates.G6_memory: draft_g3: peak Metal <= 15.5 GiB and no pageouts (absolute budget declared because the draft cannot pass the frozen relative guard); serial_finals: peak RSS/Metal <= max(control) + max(10 %,256 MiB)
gates.G7_health: rc 0, no timeout, lifecycle status recorded, chunk_count within +-10 % of the clip's mean control
gates.n: gemma-routed silence finals per arm >= 50 per clip and >= 100 across clips for p95_claim_eligible; otherwise a screen without p95 claim

outcome_rule: PASS only if every gate holds on both clips -> eligible for a later confirmation with visible ACKs (tools/overnight_bench.py); otherwise REJECTED naming the gate. No default changes and no combination arm follow from this screen.
excluded: every closed arm in docs/latency_next_experiments.md (incl. the live E2B draft and serial_finals); no combination this series
